customManagers.description: golangci-lint version passed to golangci-lint-action in CI.
Actions runner tarball for the image. The version and its SHA-256 update together; the hash comes from the release asset's digest.

actions-runner.description: Stable actions/runner releases, each with the SHA-256 GitHub records for its linux-x64 tarball. Releases without that asset digest are left out, so a version never lands with a stale hash.
transformTemplates: { "releases": [$[draft = false and prerelease = false].($v := $substringAfter(tag_name, "v"); $d := assets[name = "actions-runner-linux-x64-" & $v & ".tar.gz"].digest; $type($d) = "string" and $contains($d, /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/) ? { "version": $v, "releaseTimestamp": published_at, "digest": $substringAfter($d, "sha256:"), "changelogUrl": html_url })], "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/actions/runner" }

packageRules.description: Pinned image and tool versions always get a human.
